reviews.title: Calm, restful and stylish hotel. Really good food and drinks served by delightful staff.
reviews.text:
Bar and restaurant staff were fab - so lovely - very polite, helpful and fun. 
Hotel lobby was beautifully calm and peaceful. We really liked the Bauhaus / Mexican décor throughout. 
Food in the restaurant was really good, we ended up eating in every night! 
Gardens and fire pits were relaxing and not too crowded. 
Close proximity to Scottsdale without noise and crowds. Layout of hotel meant residents had space.
Would definitely go back if in Scottsdale.
Ability to park so close to hotel room with easy access to room from carpark - really well designed.
Access to ice outside rooms. / Overcrowding at the pool. Many beds held for residents with towels all day and not used. However when I went for brief lunch I came back to discover my belongings had been moved and I had to go to my room. On a 4 day stay I had a lounger for 2 days only. Large numbers of day packages meant overnight residents were competing for lounger access. Hotel staff could possibly allocate / oversee? 

I was unable to secure a spa booking, there were not enough therapists and a lot of external 'day' bookings. The lady on reception at the spa was most apologetic and so lovely though!

The young lady on reception for our check in. The only staff member in the whole 4 day stay who wasn't pleasant. She was unfortunately rude, gave no details regarding breakfast times, spa access, pool times / towels - just pointed and instructed "go ask them". When I couldn't locate spa staff "I told you ask them!". I just avoided over future days and everyone else was really brilliant.

reviews.title: My meant to be relaxing vacation was anything but. I understand there are several lovely resorts in Scottsdale and my ad
reviews.text: The property was clean and was well landscaped.  Rooms were comfortable, although not worthy of their nightly fee. The lobby was pretty with a Cuban vibe. I will say, the spa was the highlight of the trip.  My massage was excellent and the technician very professional! / The management/front desk was completely incompetent. I was locked out of my room 3 times.  It was impossible to speak to anyone at the front desk so one of the times, I had to walk around the entire circumference of the property to get a new key. I decided to stay an extra and was initially told I could stay in the same room, then told I couldn’t.  No problem, I said, I’m fine with a different room.  When I received my invoice that day, I was charged over $900 and my charge card was charged for $1200. My previous room was $550.  I was told my the manager that he would match the price and didn’t.  I also paid for a package when booking my room that included a $200 food credit.  I didn’t receive that either. Finally, on my last day there after being charged $900 for my room, I was informed that the pool would close at 2:00 for a private event.  There was another pool but much smaller without a poolside bar. the on site restaurant was ok but the service was very slow and the music VERY loud.  My family and I had a difficult time having a conversation while dining.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Very, very comfortable bed. Nice relaxing patio area. Easy access to Uber transportation. / Breakfast at the restaurant. Entrees too elaborate; portions way too large. Coffee cups without handles - too hot to handle so one has to wait until coffee cools to pick it up and drink. I asked for a side of smoked salmon and was  presented with a portion the size of an entire fish slopped onto a small saucer. Food presentations need refinement. The fried plantain included in the Eggs Benedict is impossible to cut with the knife provided. The crusts on the avocado and smoked salmon toasts are tough and chewy. I've worked in food service for 30 years, and providing food that is palatable and easy to eat is an important consideration. I noticed a lot of food wasted - left on plates, and this may be the reason behind it.

We also had a problem with water coming out the bottom of the shower door and causing a good size puddle on the floor.

We had every intention of exploring Scottsdale and going shopping and wasting time at other restaurants but we could not bring ourselves to want to leave the resort!! The espresso martinis, the carne asada tacos, the absolute beauty of the decor (and staff) it was all worthy of a 5 star stay in Tulum.
